title: Crown
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='gold' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e0a800'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='goldDark' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f0c020'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b8860b'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- crown body -->
  <path d='M18 78 L22 38 L36 56 L50 24 L64 56 L78 38 L82 78 Z'
        fill='url(#gold)' stroke='#b8860b' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- base band -->
  <rect x='18' y='76' width='64' height='14' rx='4' fill='url(#goldDark)' stroke='#a07000' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- band highlight -->
  <rect x='23' y='79' width='54' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffe98a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- gems on band -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='83' r='4' fill='#ff3b6b' stroke='#c02050' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='83' r='4.5' fill='#3bc8ff' stroke='#1f8fbf' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='83' r='4' fill='#7dff5c' stroke='#3fbf2a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- gem glints -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='81.5' r='1.2' fill='#fff0f4'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='81' r='1.4' fill='#eaf8ff'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='81.5' r='1.2' fill='#f0fff0'/>
  <!-- tips -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='36' r='6' fill='#ffd23f' stroke='#c99a00' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='6.5' fill='#ffd23f' stroke='#c99a00' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='36' r='6' fill='#ffd23f' stroke='#c99a00' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- tip pearls -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#fff6c2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='2.8' fill='#fff6c2'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#fff6c2'/>
  <!-- small gem accents on points -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='54' r='3' fill='#c86bff' stroke='#8f3fc0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='54' r='3' fill='#c86bff' stroke='#8f3fc0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
</svg>
